content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Bitcoin payments for digital downloads refer to the process of accepting cryptocurrency as payment for digital products such as [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-sell-ebooks-kenya-honest-side-side-breakdown-4|How to]], courses, and templates. This method allows creators to bypass conventional payment processors that often impose high fees or may not be accessible at all. With [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-explained-digital-15|COREMERCH guide to nowpayments]], creators can implement a seamless payment solution that incurs only a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This means that more revenue remains with the creator, allowing for better sustainability and growth.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for Bitcoin payments involves several key components working together to enable automatic delivery and payment confirmation. By utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for transaction processing, creators can set up an efficient system. When a customer completes a purchase, the payment is verified on-chain, triggering an automatic delivery of the digital product. This process eliminates the need for manual intervention, streamlining the experience for both creators and buyers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is designed specifically for digital creators in regions with limited access to conventional payment platforms. Whether you are selling ebooks, digital art, or software, the ability to accept Bitcoin drastically expands your market potential. Since many creators face payment rejection due to geographical restrictions, this infrastructure empowers them to take control of their sales without being hindered by financial isolation. It’s about sovereignty in commerce for creators who have been locked out of traditional systems.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, keeping more money in your pocket.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To successfully implement Bitcoin payments for digital downloads, several components are essential. Firstly, an effective hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages is required for your online storefront. Backend logic can be managed via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment processing and order management. Order data can be stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, while file delivery can be managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. All of these elements work in tandem to create a seamless and efficient infrastructure, ensuring that creators maintain full ownership of their operations.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start accepting Bitcoin payments, first choose your digital product and set it up on a platform like GitHub Pages. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automation. Integrate NOWPayments for secure payment processing. Store your product orders in Supabase or Google Sheets, and ensure that your files are hosted on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. For a comprehensive start, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to get you up and running quickly.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This platform allows you to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, charging only a 0.5% fee, compared to higher fees from traditional platforms. This approach not only reduces costs but also expands your reach in regions where conventional payment methods are restricted.
Automation with Cloudflare Workers makes delivery seamless.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without the constraints of PayPal or Stripe, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides everything needed to establish a sovereign digital commerce stack, empowering creators to take control of their sales.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by setting up your own online store with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions.
How can I automate delivery of my digital products?

You can automate the delivery of your digital products using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools can handle payment confirmations and trigger the automatic delivery of files to customers.

Using Bitcoin for transactions offers several advantages, including lower fees, no need for buyer accounts, and the ability to accept payments from anywhere in the world without geographical restrictions.
